description:
Serialize the completion's (WorkStartReason, causes) in jsonl.rs alongside the existing changed/wakes/movements/blocked, and the product trigger from fz-0am.6 on the evaluated event.

Honour the surviving half of the original arc constraint: a telemetry-off run costs nothing. The mechanism already exists in-repo -- pull.rs gates its causal product events on causal_product_events_enabled / emit_causal_products, emitting them only when telemetry asks. Extend that pattern rather than inventing a flag.

Done when a public log answers 'why did this evaluation run' by reading one record, with no cross-position join.
title: Project the carried cause onto the public stream
